settings.emos_reference: Gneiting et al. (2005), nonhomogeneous Gaussian regression; Thorarinsdottir and Gneiting (2010), truncated-normal EMOS. Application here uses log1p discharge.

score_contract.evaluation: Unchanged current post_crps_quantile_approx; sorted grid with tau=k/(2001)
score_contract.training: Analytic truncated-normal CRPS, averaged across pre-origin mature forecast pairs
score_contract.predictive_grid: 2000 deterministic quantiles p=k/2001; climatology type-1 empirical quantiles; persistence repeats last observation
score_contract.skill: 1 - sum(model scores)/sum(matched seasonal climatology scores); no daily-ratio average
score_contract.calendar: Circular 366-slot reference year 2000; February 29 retained as its own slot; +/-15 slots

training_isolation: Each fit receives only USGS dates <=T, issues<T, matured targets<=T, current product family; verification is matched only after prediction

optimizer.selection: lowest analytic training CRPS among converged starts
optimizer.variance: unbiased within-ensemble sample variance of log1p members (ddof=1)
optimizer.parameters: mu=a+b*m; sigma2=exp(log_c)+d*v; monotone b>=0, d>=0; numeric safety bounds audited
optimizer.gradient: Projected gradient infinity norm in scaled optimizer coordinates; raw norm also retained
